towns.name: Lagos
towns.vibeLine: The backpacker-turned-upscale hub with dramatic cliffs and genuine old-town charm.
towns.stayIf: You want walkable beaches, good restaurants, and a lively atmosphere without the Albufeira chaos.
towns.skipIf: You prefer absolute quiet or want to be near the eastern Algarve and Ria Formosa.
towns.dayTripPotential: Perfect base for the western Algarve. Sagres 30min, Silves 45min, Monchique 50min.

towns.name: Tavira
towns.vibeLine: The elegant, authentic town that feels like the Algarve of 30 years ago.
towns.stayIf: You want Portuguese authenticity, beautiful architecture, and easy access to Ria Formosa islands.
towns.skipIf: You need dramatic cliff beaches (the eastern beaches are flat and sandy).
whereToEat: Casa do Polvo in Santa Luzia
towns.dayTripPotential: Eastern gateway. Spanish border 25min, Faro 30min, Ria Formosa islands by ferry.

towns.name: Faro
towns.vibeLine: The underrated capital — a real working city with an atmospheric old town.
towns.stayIf: You want an authentic Portuguese city experience with easy connections everywhere.
towns.skipIf: You're here purely for beach time and don't care about urban life.
towns.dayTripPotential: Central location. Beach islands by ferry, Tavira 30min, Albufeira 40min, Loulé 20min.

towns.name: Silves
towns.vibeLine: The ancient Moorish capital, now a peaceful inland retreat with incredible history.
towns.stayIf: You want to experience the interior Algarve — cork forests, orange groves, and medieval streets.
towns.skipIf: Beach access is your priority (closest beach is 20min drive).

towns.name: Sagres
towns.vibeLine: The end of the world — raw, windswept, and utterly magnetic for surfers and dreamers.
towns.stayIf: You want wild Atlantic energy, world-class waves, and don't mind limited dining options.
towns.skipIf: You need calm beaches for swimming or want nightlife beyond a few bars.

towns.name: Olhão
towns.vibeLine: A working fishing town where tourism hasn't smoothed the edges — in the best way.
towns.stayIf: You want to live like a local in a real Portuguese town with amazing seafood.
towns.skipIf: You want pretty historic buildings (Olhão is functional, not picturesque).
towns.dayTripPotential: Ria Formosa gateway. Islands by ferry, Tavira 20min, Faro 15min.

towns.name: Loulé
towns.vibeLine: The artisan heart of the Algarve — markets, craftsmen, and zero pretense.
towns.stayIf: You want an inland base with easy access to everywhere and incredible Saturday markets.
towns.skipIf: You need to be within walking distance of beaches.

towns.name: Carvoeiro
towns.vibeLine: A family-friendly former fishing village that's kept its charm despite development.
bestFor: those seeking a middle ground between quiet and lively
towns.stayIf: You want beautiful cliff beaches, good restaurants, and a compact walkable center.
towns.skipIf: You hate crowds (the beach gets packed) or want a truly authentic Portuguese town.
towns.dayTripPotential: Central coast base. Benagil caves 10min, Silves 15min, Portimão 10min.
